_comment: Aetheris architecture & training spec override. Copy this file to 'aetheris_spec.json' (next to the package) or point AETHERIS_SPEC_FILE at it, then fill in the authoritative values from the 'Aetheris Training & Architecture Blueprint (Hermes Agent Foundation)' PDF. Every field is optional — omitted fields fall back to the blueprint-derived defaults. The 'evidence' tags ('blueprint' | 'scaffold' | 'pending') record where each value came from.

architecture.name: Aetheris
architecture.hallucination_policy: reduced hallucination rates via grounded synthesis

transformer.note: Populate from the Hermes Agent Foundation blueprint.

stages.name: Domain-Adaptive Continued Pretraining
stages.objective: Adapt the base decoder-only backbone to Aetheris target domains.
stages.notes: Fill corpus and schedule from the Hermes blueprint.

stages.name: Supervised Fine-Tuning (Instruction Alignment)
stages.objective: Instruction alignment across code, prose, and JSON.

stages.name: Direct Preference Optimization
stages.objective: Preference alignment to reduce hallucination and enforce schema fidelity.

stages.name: Agentic Tool-Use Instruction Tuning
stages.objective: Multi-step planning, tool selection, and self-correction.
stages.notes: Extends the blueprint's 'autonomous tool usage' capability.

stages.name: Meta-Learning (Learning-to-Learn Adaptation)
stages.objective: Learning-to-learn adaptation: rapid few-shot generalization to novel tasks, tools, and domains.
stages.notes: Second pillar of the Hermes Agent + Meta-Learning foundation.

stages.name: Evaluation & Red-Teaming
stages.objective: Validate output fidelity across JSON schemas, math proofs, and NL; gate on hallucination rate.
